text: Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> There came a third knock. <break time="0.8s" /> And when the door was opened. <break time="0.8s" /> A short man in a neat dark suit. <break time="0.8s" /> Stood on the step. <break time="0.8s" /> He began to ask the way. <break time="0.8s" /> To a nearby village. <break time="0.8s" /> But his eyes fell upon the man in gray. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was still singing by the fire. <break time="0.8s" /> His face turned white. <break time="0.8s" /> His knees shook. <break time="0.8s" /> And without saying another word. <break time="0.8s" /> He turned and ran out. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the stormy night. <break time="0.8s" /> As fast as he could. <break time="0.8s" /> The guests were still wondering. <break time="0.8s" /> What had frightened him so much. <break time="0.8s" /> When a heavy boom sounded. <break time="0.8s" /> Across the hills. <break time="0.8s" /> From the direction of Casterbridge. <break time="0.8s" /> That is the jail gun. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the hangman. <break time="0.8s" /> Jumping up. <break time="0.8s" /> And it means. <break time="0.8s" /> That a prisoner has escaped. <break time="0.8s" /> Surely the very man I came for. <break time="0.8s" /> Everyone at once concluded. <break time="0.8s" /> That the little man who had run away. <break time="0.8s" /> Must be the escaped prisoner. <break time="0.8s" /> Since nobody else would have fled. <break time="0.8s" /> At the sight of the hangman. <break time="0.8s" /> The hangman urged the constable. <break time="0.8s" /> Who happened to be among the guests. <break time="0.8s" /> To gather the men at once. <break time="0.8s" /> And chase the runaway. <break time="0.8s" /> Across the dark hills. <break time="0.8s" /> So with lanterns and sticks in their hands. <break time="0.8s" /> The men hurried out into the rain. <break time="0.8s" /> Leaving the warm room. <break time="0.8s" /> Almost empty behind them.
